rationale: The only implementation delta is the ordering of io_get_open_fptr(mrb, orig): the fixed version validates/retrieves the original IO pointer before finalizing and freeing any existing data in copy, whereas the vulnerable version does so afterward. The Logic section does not state this ordering or describe validation before cleanup. Its claims about retrieving the original object, finalizing existing copy data, allocating resources, duplicating descriptors, copying attributes, error handling for duplication failure, and returning copy are true of both versions.
